remarks:
Experience the ultimate in low-maintenance living at Midtown Townhomes in Marrano's move-in ready Winston townhome design. This brand new home is situated in a two-unit building backing a common area with abundant natural light. Located off Cloverleaf Dr and Transit Rd, across from Hillview Elementary, this community offers a premier location and the benefit of condo status for significant property tax savings. An association handles exterior maintenance, allowing you to spend more time enjoying your home and less time on chores.

The interior features a thoughtful layout designed for convenience with a first floor primary bedroom with walk-in closet and private bath, as well as first floor laundry, an attached 2-car garage, powder room for guests and an open-concept kitchen and family room. The bright kitchen is appointed with quartz countertops, white maple soft-close cabinetry, and a stainless steel dishwasher and microwave. A sliding glass door leads from the main living area to your backyard space, perfect for relaxing outdoors.

On the second floor are two additional bedrooms and a second full bath, providing plenty of space for family or a home office. Additional features include a gas fireplace, luxury vinyl flooring, recessed lighting, a full basement, and Marrano's peace-of-mind warranty. Photos are of a similar home. Model is located at 20 Cloverleaf Ct. #1, Sat-Wed 1:00pm-5:00pm. Taxes are TBD.
